mainEntity.name: When should my multi-location business consider investing in a GEO strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your multi-location business should consider investing in a GEO strategy as soon as you have more than one physical location serving local customers. It's particularly crucial if you rely on foot traffic, local searches, or online inquiries directed to specific branches. Early adoption ensures consistent brand messaging and optimized online presence across all locations from the outset. If you're struggling to attract local customers to individual stores or clinics, or if your competitors dominate local search results, it's a clear sign to prioritize GEO.
acceptedAnswer.description: Invest in a GEO strategy when you have multiple physical locations and rely on local customers or search. It's crucial if competitors dominate local search or you need to attract more foot traffic.
